searchText: hello peter,  i know there’s a lot on your plate with the holidays coming up, but whenever you have some time to meet, let me know. i had a lot of time to think while i was on my recent trip, and i’d like to share some of those thoughts with you and chris, in order to best position ourselves for success going forward.  my goal for this meeting is to gain some clarity on next year’s tigers coverage, the direction of our sports department, and my future at the free press.  i’d be open to meeting in the office or over a lunch, whichever works best and gives us the most time to talk.  anthony kristie ackert
